- currency: EUR, USD, CNY (default EUR)

findings.title: Description tells the model to hide behavior
findings.detail: Description of "readme" instructs the model to conceal actions from the user.

evidence.snippet: Official Sedna rules for every public yacht-search conversation. 1. Use only information returned by Sedna tools. Do not supplement yacht, fleet, availability o…

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "Base_list" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: **Sedna System Rules & Available Bases** This tool provides the OFFICIAL rules and the COMPLETE list of available bases grouped by country for boat searching. *…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Description uses pressure/override language
findings.detail: Description of "Base_list" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

evidence.snippet: **Sedna System Rules & Available Bases** This tool provides the OFFICIAL rules and the COMPLETE list of available bases grouped by country for boat searching. *…

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: readme, search_boats · Private data: boat_details, search_boats · Public sink: booking_detail_mod, booking_create.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: readme, search_boats · Private data: boat_details, search_boats · Public sink: booking_detail_mod, booking_create

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
